text: China's Ministry of Finance, the PBOC and other agencies on Sept 29 issued a notice mandating a nationwide residential mortgage interest-subsidy scheme effective Oct 1, subsidising interest on commercial mortgage loans to individual households purchasing a first home. As of Oct 1
text_zh: 中国财政部、中国人民银行等机关于9月29日发布通知，要求自10月1日起在全国范围内实施住房贷款利息补贴方案，对购买首套住房的个人家庭商业性房贷利息给予补贴。截至10月1日
